hypotheses.title: Committed payment with a lost acknowledgement
hypotheses.reason: The Sample read confirms a COMPLETED USD 12.00 capture on SAMPLE-ORDER-8563cf27-42a, linked to this purchase intent. Observations report that its response was dropped before the application displayed failure.

hypotheses.title: Original capture completion was misreported
hypotheses.reason: The successful Sample read confirms the original capture, SAMPLE-CAPTURE-d503bcd8-51a, as COMPLETED, contradicting the hypothesis that the original payment never committed.

diagnosis.conclusion: In this Sample scenario, the application treated a lost acknowledgement as payment failure. Observations report a retry through a new order and a second capture: USD 24.00 captured for one USD 12.00 purchase, with one fulfillment—not multiple captures on one order. The supplied read verifies only the original order. No refund or repair is evidenced.

limitations: One task-specific diagnosis qualification; no claim about the 600-attempt context study.
